options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the code region.

options.name: code
options.description: Source text (ignored when diff is set).

options.name: diff
options.description: Show a diff: { original, modified, mode?: 'unified' | 'split', originalLabel?, modifiedLabel?, ignoreWhitespace? }.

options.name: filename
options.description: File name shown in the toolbar.

options.name: startLine
options.description: Number of the first line (code view).

options.name: highlightLines
options.description: Line numbers or [from, to] ranges to highlight (modified line numbers in a diff).

options.name: toolbar
options.description: Show the toolbar (file name, language, actions).

options.name: maxHeight
options.description: Maximum block size of the scroll area (CSS length), or null to grow with the content (no virtualization).

options.name: icons
options.description: Toolbar icons: copy, copied, unified, split.

options.name: wrap
options.description: Wrap long lines (the side-by-side diff always wraps).

options.name: tabSize
options.description: Width of a tab character in spaces (1 to 16).

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The diff mode, or null for plain code.

properties.name: diff
properties.description: The computed diff lines (null outside diff mode).

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text the copy button writes (the code, or the modified text of a diff).

properties.name: renderedRowCount
properties.description: Rows currently in the DOM (all rows unless virtualized).

methods.name: scrollToLine
methods.description: Scroll a displayed line number (modified side in a diff) into view.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copy the text to the clipboard; resolves false when the clipboard refused.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, buttons, observers, and listeners.

events.name: aui-copy
events.description: The text was written to the clipboard: { text }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user toggled wrapping or the diff mode: { wrap, mode, reason }.

cssClasses.name: aui-code-viewer__toolbar
cssClasses.description: Toolbar with file name, language, diff counts, and actions.

cssClasses.name: aui-code-viewer__row
cssClasses.description: One row (a line, or a pair of lines side by side).

cssClasses.name: aui-code-viewer__t--<type>
cssClasses.description: Token: keyword, string, number, comment, function, type, tag, attr, variable, punctuation, heading, emphasis, link, code.
